tenderSchedule.title: Annual Maintenance Contract of Campus Wide Networking (CWN) of Bangalore University for a period of 1 year
tenderSchedule.description: Annual Maintenance Contract of Campus Wide Networking (CWN) of Bangalore University for a period of 1 year

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. Bangalore University shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of Karnataka Public Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end
Tenders from Joint ventures are not acceptable. Conditional tenders will not be accepted

The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and Bangalore University will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs. The cost of the Tender Processing shall not be refundable
Bangalore University is not responsible for any delay in accessing Karnataka public Procurement Portal
The EMD & Tender processing fee shall be paid through Karnataka public procurement portal only as per the e-procurement rules
The Tenderers need to register with Karnataka public procurement portal and to obtain user ID and Password for participating in the Tender process
Bangalore University reserves the rights to Accept or Reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons
No subsequent correspondence regarding price quoted will be entertained
Bidders should abide by other terms & conditions as prescribed in relevant KTPP standard tender document and KTPP Rules and KTPP Act
The Bidder shall comply with and abide by all the terms, conditions, specifications, and requirements stipulated in the tender document.
Tender received without adequate details will be rejected
The PDF/other files to be uploaded shall be prepared using the minimum appropriate resolution required to ensure readability and clarity of the contents.
Tenderer shall not furnish the Financial Tender along with the Technical Tender. A Technical Tender containing any details of Financial Tender information shall be declared non-responsive

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have at least 3-years experience in the field of Campus Wide Network installation, commissioning, service and maintenance in any one Central Govt. /State Govt./ PSUs/ Govt Educational Institute/University/Govt Research Institutions/ Registered Private Limited Companies and other reputed private companies/firms during the last 3 financial years (i.e. Financial Year 2023-2024, 2024-2025 and 2025-2026)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant Work Orders/ Work orders/ Satisfactory work completion certificate shall be furnished

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidders experience in executing similar works may be given as a list with details as per the format given in APPENDIX iii alongwith supporting documents

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Details of bidders experience for The Last Three Years in the format  given in APPENDIX iii

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder should have qualified and experienced engineers/technicians and support team in Bengaluru for handling network issues. (List of service engineers/technicians along with their details for handling network issues available at Bengaluru shall be furnished)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- List of service engineers/technicians along with their details for handling network issues available at Bengaluru shall be furnished

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer should have a Registered/Branch Office in Bengaluru, Karnataka. If incorporated elsewhere, bidder should have support office and qualified technical support team in Bengaluru

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Documentary proof of office in Bengaluru, Karnataka shall be submitted

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer should have minimum Average Annual Turnover of Rs.50,00,000/- (Rupees Fifty Lakhs Only) from the last three completed Financial Years (i.e. Financial Year 2022-2023, 2023-2024 and 2024-2025)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Annual Turnover Certificate duly attested by Chartered Accountant with UDIN Number shall be furnished

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Income Tax Returns filed for the last 3 Financial years to be furnished (i.e. Financial Year 2022-2023, 2023-2024 and 2024-2025)
The Bidder should not be blacklisted by the Government of Karnataka or any of its department/agency or by Central / any other State/UT Government or its department/ agency for the last three years

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Self-declared Certificate signed by Authorized signatory to this effect in the letter head of the tenderer shall be furnished

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: APPENDIX ii - Details of the tenderer
Balance sheet and Profit and Loss account statement for the last 3 years , FY-2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25
Filled Checklist to be submitted on the letter head of the Tenderer
